summary: Saint-Barthélemy. Parliamentary democracy (territorial council); overseas collectivity of france.
rulers: President Emmanuel MACRON (since 14 May 2017), represented by Prefect Cyrille LE VELY (since 15 January 2025); President of Territorial Council Xavier LEDEE (since 3 April 2022)
government: parliamentary democracy (Territorial Council); overseas collectivity of France
economy: high-income French Caribbean territorial economy; duty-free luxury commerce and tourism industries; import-dependent for food, water, energy, and manufacturing; large Brazilian and Portuguese labor supply; environmentally fragile
